data.title: New releases for your streaming pleasure: Aug 5-11
data.description: Looking for a title to binge-watch this weekend? Here's our pick!

data.title: Ukraine marks 35 years  of independence with  Bangkok film festival
data.description: The Embassy of Ukraine will hold the Second Ukrainian Film Festival in Thailand at the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre from Aug 4-6, marking the 35th anniversary of Ukraine's independence. All films in the programme will be shown in Thailand for the first time.

data.title: The priceof survival
data.description: The new Apple TV limited drama series Lucky is a high-stakes thriller about survival, identity and the difficult process of escaping the life you were born into. At the centre of the story is Luciana "Lucky" Armstrong (Anya Taylor-Joy), a brilliant but troubled con artist raised by her father, John Armstrong (Timothy Olyphant), a charming career criminal who taught her everything he knew about deception and survival -- except how to escape the world he created for her.

data.title: Sounds Of Wireless stages a family affair
data.description: The Srikaranonda–Balakauskas family will give an evening concert, "Music From Our Living Room", at 140 Wireless, Witthayu Road, on Aug 15 at 4pm.

data.title: An evening shaped by grace, drama, romance and remembrance
data.description: The Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra will join hands with Bangkok City Ballet to present "A Tribute To The Loyal Legacy" in the Main Hall of Thailand Cultural Centre, Ratchadaphisek Road, on Aug 12 at 7.30pm.

data.title: Tiger suspected of mauling park ranger close to living quarters
data.description: A park ranger was found mauled in the Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary in Uthai Thani province on Wednesday morning and officials assumed he was attacked by a tiger near his living quarters.

data.title: TCMA and GIZ push low-carbon technologies to drive cement sector toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has expanded its partnership with Germany’s development agency, the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), to accelerate the adoption of low-carbon technologies in Thailand’s cement industry. The initiative, highlighted at the TCMA xGIZ at TCMA Technical Conference 2026, reflects a shift from policy commitments to implementation, under the theme: “#MadeInGermany: Cement Decarbonisation in Practice – Insights for Thailand”. The collaboration aims to transfer proven technologies and expertise from developed economies to support Thailand’s transition toward Net Zero emissions by 2050.

data.title: CLICX suspends loan applications, warns against deliberate defaults
data.description: CLICX has temporarily halted loan applications after demand exceeded forecasts, while warning that deliberate defaults could damage borrowers’ credit records.

data.title: Trump admin to review 'closed' AI models before release: reports
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - The Trump administration on Tuesday met with tech leaders to finalise a security review process for advanced AI models before their release, though it will apply only to "closed" models, US media reported.

data.title: 'Like the end of the world': the eclipse chasers flocking to Spain
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Suddenly, the world is plunged into an eerie, violet darkness. The temperature drops. Birds and other animals, bewildered by unforeseen night, start behaving strangely. Stars and planets appear in the sky next to the blotted-out Sun.

data.title: UK mansion where 'listeners' spied on Nazi generals becomes museum
data.description: ENFIELD — Upstairs, Nazi generals enjoyed wine and lounged in elegant rooms. Downstairs in the basement, a team of covert listeners followed their chatter, gleaning vital insights into Germany's war plans.

data.title: High bills, cheap panels drive a Philippine solar surge
data.description: MANILA - Edwin Salas watched as the first of 20 solar panels was installed on the roof of his home, joining a Philippine solar energy boom sent into overdrive by the Middle East war.

data.title: Bond Yields Move FX More Than Headlines: Here's Why
data.description: In the past, traders in the foreign exchange (forex) market would pay most of their attention to central banks, economies and politics. Although these three elements remain important, more traders are paying attention to yet another element – government bond yields.

data.title: True Corporation Reports Sixth Consecutive Quarter of Profitability
data.description: True Corporation announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, delivering another quarter of profitability supported by topline recovery and disciplined financial management. Despite heightened macroeconomic headwinds, operational performance remained positive across all business segments. For the quarter, the Company reported Net Profit After Tax of THB 6.6 billion, while EBITDA reached THB 28.3 billion, increasing 13.5% year-on-year.

data.title: Risk-On or Risk-Off? How to Read Global Sentiment Before You Trade
data.description: Financial markets are not only affected by economic indicators and corporate performance but also by the sentiments of investors. Every day in trading markets, people decide whether they want to seek risk or avoid it. This is called risk-on and risk-off sentiment.

data.title: Central Bank Policy: Its Impact on the Currency Market
data.description: Central banks have an important influence on the foreign exchange market. Decisions regarding interest rates, policy statements, inflation projections and economic growth all influence the value of currencies relative to one another. In the forex market, understanding central bank policy is vital, as it is often the primary driver of currency movements.

data.title: Inflation Is Back: What the Next CPI Release Means for Traders
data.description: One theme that is making its return to the global financial markets is that of inflation. Following a long period during which there has been relative calm on the inflation front, rising pressures from commodity prices have forced traders to look at the prospects for inflation, central bank policy, and market conditions once again.

data.title: SpaceX rocket stage expected to slam into Moon
data.description: NEW YORK - A SpaceX rocket's upper stage is set to unintentionally crash into the Moon on Wednesday, a collision that poses no danger to Earth but will leave behind a lunar crater.

data.title: Trump's sale of access to Truth Social raises eyebrows
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump's move to charge for early access to his often market-moving Truth Social posts is raising eyebrows a year and a half into an administration that has already seen unprecedented enrichment for the First Family.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 5
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Thailand property market shaken by nominee crackdown on luxury homes
data.description: Thailand’s probe into nominee structures linked to foreign buyers has put 33 luxury homes worth 1.27 billion baht under scrutiny and raised market concerns

data.title: From bad loans to court as 1.85 million accounts enter legal process
data.description: Thailand’s credit bureau data shows 1.85 million loan accounts worth 580 billion baht have entered legal proceedings after becoming bad debt

data.title: Teenage Vareeraya to lead Thai bid at Asian Games
data.description: Skateboarder Vareeraya Sukasem will lead Thailand's challenge in extreme sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month after the Thailand Extreme Sports Association (Tesa) has announced a nine-member team for the continental championship.

data.title: Shot in the arm for U17 team
data.description: Thailand's under‑17 side has been handed a favourable position in Pot One for the forthcoming AFC U17 Asian Cup Uzbekistan 2027 qualifiers, underlining the country's growing stature in youth football across Asia.

data.title: Bangkok council chief issues warning over vote-card misuse
data.description: The chair of the Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) has warned that councillors found guilty of serious ethical violations over alleged vote-card misuse could face removal from office, as the council begins reviewing complaints over the alleged misconduct.

data.title: Fixes sought for missing person cases
data.description: The Mirror Foundation has urged the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to overhaul Thailand's missing persons tracking system by adopting six key measures.

data.title: Mor Prom app data errors investigated
data.description: Over 7,000 people have complained about inaccurate medical records on the Mor Prom app, prompting the Public Health Ministry to pledge legal action against anyone deliberately entering false data.

data.title: Manhunt for cop killers widens
data.description: A manhunt for six suspects accused of killing two police officers in Narathiwat has intensified after investigators found evidence suggesting they may have fled across the border.

data.title: Two agencies join data leak investigation
data.description: Two government agencies have launched a joint investigation after vehicle registration and personal data were circulated online, although authorities say the source of the apparent leak has yet to be identified.

data.title: People's Party rejects claims of harassment cover-up
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) has rejected allegations that it pressured a former lawmaker to remain silent after she reported being sexually harassed by a fellow member of its predecessor, the Move Forward Party (MFP).

data.title: Vlogger's body in Turkey
data.description: The body of Thai travel YouTuber Bawornthat "Hlun Solo" Pengsuk has reached the Thai embassy in Ankara, Turkey, with repatriation to Thailand expected soon after the final documentation has been completed.
